issues.description: The present-entry unmap branch assumes that the current PTE is absent from the SPT and calls `Entry::replace` under the same impossible precondition, even though `is_present` has just established that the PTE is present.
issues.rationale: Control reaches the replacement branch only when `cur_entry.pte.is_present(spt)` returned true. Its trait contract guarantees that a true result implies the SPT PTE map contains the current PTE address. The branch then assumes the negation, and problem-side `Entry::replace` independently requires that negation. Verification therefore proceeds from a direct contradiction instead of proving removal of an actually present entry. Repair c35d78a removes both the false call-site assumption and the impossible callee precondition; the later merge preserves that repair.
issues.source_evidence: after/lock-protocol/src/mm/page_table/cursor/mod.rs:785-798 continues past the absence check only for a present entry, while lines 860-866 assume the same address is absent immediately before replacement. after/lock-protocol/src/mm/page_table/mod.rs:219-230 specifies that `is_present == true` entails PTE-map membership. after/lock-protocol/src/mm/page_table/node/entry.rs:102-116 requires non-membership. Direct repair c35d78a437acba1016012c38f2ab3c1ed085615e deletes both non-membership premises.
issues.verification: Primary and independent source reviews confirmed the control-flow/contract contradiction and the direct two-site repair. Historical Verus was not executed; any problem-side pass would rely on the explicit false assumption and would not establish soundness.
